questions.learningObjective: Carry a curl flux through a tilt in two stages
questions.stem: A two-stage table lists curl F = (0,0,2) on a flat patch of area 3.0 in the z = 0 plane. Stage one: find the circulation with the upward orientation. Stage two: find the circulation for a patch of the same area tilted 30 degrees from horizontal with the same normal sense.

options.text: Stage one gives 6.0 and stage two gives 6.0.
options.misconception: ignores the tilt in stage two

questions.explanation: The upward normal gives the vertical curl 2 over the area 3.0, so stage one is 6.0. Tilted 30 degrees only 2 cos 30 degrees acts along the normal, so stage two is about 5.20.
questions.hint: Project the curl onto each patch's own normal.
